decisions_taken: Treat the instructor as the sole academic authority
Use a hash-linked course ledger for material course and workflow events
follow_up_actions: Obtain instructor review before treating the preamble as approved course authority
summary: The IS 529 N project established a governance preamble defining instructor authority, fidelity duties, documentation architecture, the course ledger, and the separation of the active project from its historical resource repository.
title: Semester 2026 governance preamble established

decisions_taken: Treat mechanical readability as distinct from factual, pedagogical, licensing, and accessibility verification
follow_up_actions: Sanitise selected resources into traceable project-owned avatars
summary: A structural and basic integrity audit observed 405 files occupying approximately 625 MiB, spanning modification years 2013–2025. It found no zero-byte files, broken symbolic links, exact SHA-256 duplicate groups, unreadable PDFs, or failed ZIP-container tests among inspected office and e-book files.
title: Initial read-only audit of the historical resource repository

decisions_taken: Write every new or modified artifact only in the project folder
Keep the historical resource repository immutable
summary: All project-created and modified artifacts must remain in the active project folder. The historical resource repository may be inspected and copied from but must never be changed or used for generated files, caches, logs, indexes, conversions, or temporary artifacts.
title: Historical resource repository designated strictly read-only

decisions_taken: Create sanitised avatars only in the project folder
Require separate verification and instructor review before pedagogical use
follow_up_actions: Create a resource intake registry and process selected resources incrementally
summary: Selected historical resources will be copied into the project, sanitised into new traceable avatars, verified, adapted for pedagogy, and reviewed before classroom or website use. Sanitisation alone does not confer factual accuracy or academic approval.
title: Sanitised resource-avatar lifecycle adopted

decisions_taken: Map Session A to Tuesday and Session B to Friday
Distinguish planned decks from evidence of classes actually conducted
summary: The course comprises fifteen weekly lecture units. Each week ordinarily has Session A on Tuesday from 09:00 to 11:00 and Session B on Friday from 09:00 to 11:00, normally supported by one presentation deck per session.
title: Fifteen-week two-session teaching cadence recorded

decisions_taken: Use main as the initial local branch
Keep the historical resource repository outside project version-control writes
summary: The active project folder was initialised as a Git repository on branch main. The governance preamble was recorded in root commit <LOCAL_GIT_COMMIT> with no resource-repository changes.
title: Project Git repository initialised and governance preamble committed
